title: Chess game with Gaddafi on Russia Day

tellings.quote: was nowhere to be seen. And then I arrived. It was the 12th of June, Russia day.

plain: In Tripoli in 2011, the guest introduced as president of a Russian republic says he went to play chess with Libya's leader Muammar Gaddafi, who "was nowhere to be seen" until he finally arrived. He dates it to 12 June, Russia Day. He tells Michels this himself, as part of his own life story, which on the show also includes a claim that he was taken by aliens in 1997.
